inputs.original_text: White House border czar Tom Homan on Tuesday did not rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are “afraid of.” Homan’s comments, made during an appearance on “The Charlie Kirk Show,” are the latest in the back and forth as the Trump administration gives inconsistent answers over whether they...
inputs.modified_text: This isn’t reassurance; it’s a pressure tactic. Tom Homan refused to rule out enforcement at polling places, then asked what Democrats are “afraid of.” That sows doubt about whether voting is safe while giving the administration room to deny it meant to intimidate anyone. The conflicting answers look less like confusion than a way to keep the threat alive without taking responsibility.
